Summary: Mercy is God's compassion toward the miserable and guilty, withholding the judgment we deserve and moving to relieve our distress. From Exodus to the Gospels, God delights in mercy and calls His people blessed when they show it to others. Every believer lives daily on mercy, receiving fresh compassion each morning.
KeyPassages: Exodus 34:6-7; Psalm 103:8-13; Lamentations 3:22-23; Micah 7:18; Matthew 5:7; Luke 6:36; Titus 3:5; James 2:13
RelatedQuestions: What is the difference between mercy and grace?; How can I show mercy without excusing sin?
RelatedBooks: Exodus; Psalms; Lamentations; Micah; Matthew; Titus
RelatedEvents: The Prodigal Son; The Good Samaritan
